media_work.title: Amanda Knox
media_work.focus_or_theme: The case of Amanda Knox, an American student accused, convicted, and ultimately exonerated for the 2007 murder of her roommate Meredith Kercher in Perugia, Italy. Explores the intense media scrutiny, controversial evidence, and complexities of the Italian justice system.
media_work.summaryNotes: Knox spent nearly four years in an Italian prison before her final acquittal in 2015.

media_item.focus_or_theme: The case of Amanda Knox, an American student accused, convicted, and ultimately exonerated for the 2007 murder of her roommate Meredith Kercher in Perugia, Italy. Explores the intense media scrutiny, controversial evidence, and complexities of the Italian justice system.
media_item.summary_notes: Documentary about Amanda Knox, an American student accused, convicted, and ultimately exonerated for the murder of Meredith Kercher in Italy. Explores media scrutiny, controversial evidence, and the Italian justice system.
key_quotes_raw: Likely features interviews with Knox, co-defendant Raffaele Sollecito, prosecutors, journalists, and archival footage of the media frenzy and trials.
Knox reflecting on being seen as either a "psychopath in sheep's clothing" or "you."
systemic_issues_raw: Trial by media/media sensationalism's impact on justice
Unreliability of forensic evidence/DNA contamination issues
The psychological toll of wrongful accusation and imprisonment
policy_recommendations_raw: Implicitly calls for responsible media coverage of criminal cases

featured_individuals.crime_convicted_of_raw: Murder of Meredith Kercher (Exonerated) (Note: A related slander conviction was also recently examined/overturned regarding statements made during initial interrogations).
featured_individuals.narrative_summary: Amanda Knox was convicted of the murder of Meredith Kercher in Perugia, Italy, in 2009. Her conviction was overturned in 2011, reinstated in 2014, and definitively overturned in 2015. She spent nearly 4 years in prison before her final exoneration.
contributing_factors_raw: Intense media sensationalism and negative portrayal ("Foxy Knoxy")
Disputed and potentially contaminated DNA evidence
organizations_involved_raw: Various legal teams in Italy and supporters in the US
